headline: Sets the order of State Department officials who would act as Secretary of State if top leaders cannot serve.
what_it_does: This executive order sets up a list, or order of succession, for the Department of State. The list says which officials would step in to do the Secretary of State's job if the Secretary and other top leaders die, resign, or cannot do their duties. No summary was provided, so the exact officials named and their order are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Officials named in the order could be called on to temporarily act as Secretary of State in the order listed.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely on signing, December 28, 2001, though no summary was provided to confirm this.
